title: Solutions relationships
description: Editorial graph edges between Solutions and Product Docs pages. Lives in the solutions repo at docs/modules/ROOT/partials/relationships.yml and is read by the solutions-catalog Antora extension through the content catalog, so the file is versioned with the content it describes. Editors and the ML suggestion bot both PR into this one file. Only `approved` entries influence what readers see; `rejected` suppresses an edge the category matcher would otherwise show; `pending` is ignored by the build until a reviewer changes it.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Only 1 exists.

relationships.description: One entry per (solution, doc) pair. The same pair twice is a build failure.

solution.description: Solution id. Equals the Antora module name and the directory under solutions/.

doc.description: Fully qualified Antora page ID of the Product Docs page (component:module:relative/path.adoc). A version prefix is allowed but the build resolves against the latest version.

status.description: approved: shown with score max(0.9, confidence). rejected: never shown, even if categories overlap. pending: awaiting review, ignored by the build.

confidence.description: Proposer confidence. For approved entries the build uses max(0.9, confidence) as the score.

reason.description: Why the pair is related. Surfaces in solutions-graph.json and the UI's debug view.

reviewedBy.description: GitHub handle or email of the reviewer who set the status.

reviewedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the status was set. Quote it in YAML or leave it unquoted; the build loads YAML without timestamp coercion.
